description: Live speed and congestion of road sections on the national freeways, provincial highways or a city’s roads, most congested first, with a count of sections per congestion level. Freeway sections are named after interchanges, so search them by keyword; city sections can also be searched by lat/lon. Example: network "freeway", keyword "林口"; or network "Taipei", lat 25.0478, lon 121.517.

direction.description: Only sections heading this way (S also matches SE and SW).

keyword.description: Only results whose road or place contains this, e.g. "國道1號", "林口", "建國高架".

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return (default 20).

network.description: Road network: "freeway" (國道, national freeways), "highway" (省道, provincial highways) or a city (Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, 臺北市, ...).

name: traffic_live
title: Live road traffic
